meta.name: kling
meta.description: Generate video and images with Kling AI models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Kling Video V4, V4 Flash, O1 (Omni), V3, Kling Avatar, Lip Sync, Video-to-Audio, Image V3, Image 3O, Virtual Try-On. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video with start and end frames, 3-30s duration, native audio, automatic shot-splitting, reference-image and reference-video editing, talking avatars, lip sync, sound effects and music for video, text-to-image up to 4K, clothing try-on. Use for: cinematic clips, product videos, social media, dubbing, digital presenters, fashion try-on. Triggers: kling, kling ai, kling 4, kling v4, kling 4.0, kling flash, kling o1, kling omni, kling 3, kling v3, kling avatar, kling lip sync, kling lipsync, kolors, kling image, kling try-on, virtual try-on, kuaishou video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
